title: Beam Global (NASDAQ: BEEM) & ScoutDI CEOs Discuss Strategic Acquisition and Drone Platform
summary: Beam Global (NASDAQ: BEEM) & ScoutDI CEOs Discuss Strategic Acquisition and Drone Platform
body_markdown:
Beam Global (NASDAQ: BEEM) CEO Desmond Wheatley joins ScoutDI CEO Nicolai Husteli to discuss Beam Global’s definitive agreement to acquire ScoutDI and the strategic opportunity to build a vertically integrated U.S. drone platform serving industrial and defense markets. In this interview, the two CEOs discuss ScoutDI’s established drone technology and AI-enhanced inspection software, the opportunity to expand U.S. manufacturing, and the potential to bring advanced drone solutions to new markets through Beam Global’s global manufacturing capabilities and customer relationships. The conversation explores how combining ScoutDI’s drone systems and recurring software revenues with Beam Global’s battery expertise, manufacturing infrastructure and BeamFlight™ technology could create new opportunities across industrial inspection, energy, security and defense applications.


Key topics include:


- The strategic rationale behind the proposed ScoutDI acquisition
- Industrial drone technology and AI-enhanced inspection software
- U.S. manufacturing and opportunities in government and defense markets
- Battery technology and integrated drone charging solutions
- Future growth opportunities across global markets
